comment: Customer 360 golden client hub (SCD2, D11): one golden client = one legal entity resolved across core banking, CRM, KYC, credit, trade, treasury and the external company master. Identity comes from entity resolution (silver.client_golden_identity); segment, tier, industry and coverage office are resolved once (best source first, then the client group, then the Tokyo HO group master); month-end states of primary RM, internal rating / IFRS 9 stage, EWS band, watchlist, KYC risk / next review, account plan and external rating are collapsed into versions with valid_from / valid_to / is_current. Facts carry the golden_client_sk of the version valid on their date (as-was); is_current = true gives today's view (as of 30-Sep-2026). Arrays (aliases, source_systems_present) also exist as text copies. Grain: one row per golden client version (calendar-month validity; current version open-ended to 9999-12-31).
